# T5C - The 5th Continent

> T5C is a free multiplayer 3D top-down browser RPG set in Eldoria.

Players can explore shared environments, fight enemies, complete quests, collect and equip loot, improve their characters, and use global chat. The game runs directly in a WebGL-capable browser and does not require an install.

## Canonical pages

- Play: https://arkadii.world/game/
- Technical documentation: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/
- Localization and controls: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/#localization_and_controls
- API and security reference: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/#api_and_security
- Game quality audit: https://arkadii.world/game/docs/#game_quality_audit
- Source repository: https://github.com/senior-13j/t5c-platform-devOps

## Technology

The browser client uses Babylon.js and TypeScript. Multiplayer rooms use Colyseus over WebSockets, with an Express API and SQL persistence. Players choose English or Russian and a keyboard/mouse or touch profile before entering. Keyboard play supports WASD, hotkeys, mouse camera control, and chat; touch play uses a virtual joystick, world swipes, a tappable hotbar, and action controls. The web shell includes an accessible preference/login flow, responsive portrait and landscape layouts, and bilingual structured VideoGame metadata.
